thread:
kevin: FYI VertexSI's field team hit an outage during onboarding. Their agent is failing to POST telemetry to our EU ingest - receiving TLS handshake errors + 403s. Need architecture review + escalation. Can someone triage?

natalie: got the alert. can you drop the exact error and the customer node id?

kevin: Error snippet from node-az-02: `POST /v1/telemetry HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Server: redwood-ingest
X-Error: client-identity-missing
`  node id `vh-az-node-02`. they call `ingest.eu.redwood.example.com:443`.

jia: looking at our ingress logs - we see their TLS ClientHello but no SNI present in ~30% of attempts, and when SNI present it's `ingest.redwood-eu`. also a few KS mismatch alerts in the gateway logs.

omar: VertexSI told field they rolled an agent build that pins openssl 1.1.1 -> possible SNI behavior change? can we confirm required TLS version/cipher suites?

eric: Redwood edge requires TLS1.2+ and expects SNI = `ingest.redwood-eu`. ciphers: ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 or ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384. Also we recently tightened header validation to require `X-Auth-Provider` header for SI-proxied agents.

natalie: immediate mitigation options: 1) have SI temporarily enable mTLS on agent so it presents cert (we'll trust VertexSI onboarding CA), 2) provide a small agent patch that forces SNI and the header, 3) fallback plan: agent writes batched payloads to S3 which we ingest asynchronously.

kevin: VertexSI prefers option 2 (fast patch). they asked for a preflight checklist and a thumbprint they can pin.

omar: cert thumbprint (sha256) = `F1:9B:3A:4C:7D:EE:11:22:33:44:55:66:77:88:99:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE`. CA bundle downloadable at `https://downloads.redwood.example.com/ca/onboarding-ca.pem` (temp).

jia: share quick curl they can run from the customer host to validate network + SNI + client cert path:

```
curl -v --resolve ingest.eu.redwood.example.com:443:35.198.12.45
  https://ingest.eu.redwood.example.com/v1/telemetry
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -H "X-Auth-Provider: vertexsi"
  --tlsv1.2 --ciphers 'ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256'
  --cert /opt/vertexsi/certs/onboard-client.pem --key /opt/vertexsi/certs/onboard-client.key
```

eric: network preflight: VertexSI NAT ranges -> `10.10.0.0/22`; allow outbound to Redwood ingress `35.198.12.0/24` and `35.199.45.0/24` on TCP/443.

natalie: field-friendly agent config diff (VertexSI can push this via their provisioner):

```
# /etc/vertexsi/agent.yaml
telemetry:
  endpoint: https://ingest.eu.redwood.example.com/v1/telemetry
  tls:
    enable: true
    sni: ingest.redwood-eu
    min_version: TLS1.2
    ciphers:
      - ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256
  headers:
    X-Auth-Provider: vertexsi
  mTLS:
    enabled: false  # set true only if CA imported
    client_cert: /opt/vertexsi/certs/onboard-client.pem
    client_key: /opt/vertexsi/certs/onboard-client.key
```

omar: i've opened a high-priority ticket with infra to relax the header drop for onboarding if we need to move fast.

kevin: can we do a 30m sync at 16:00 UTC to walk VertexSI through the patch? they need the calendar invite + preflight checklist.

eric: 16:00 UTC works. i'll attach the CA bundle to the invite and include the curl + runbook snippet. also adding rollback steps (switch to S3 batch).

natalie: I'll own post-call follow-up and ensure field runbook is copied to the SI Confluence page + partner onboarding tracker. tagging @vertexsi-eng in the invite.

kevin: thanks team. proceeding to schedule and escalating to Delivery Lead. :thumbsup:
